app_store.name: GDM: Genius Download Manager
app_store.subtitle: Downloads you control
app_store.promotional_text: Takes over only the downloads you choose, and leaves the rest to your browser.
app_store.description:
GDM speeds up downloads with several connections and lets you pause and resume them, even after a restart.

The browser add-on hands over the downloads you want. File types you pick, such as images, stay with the browser. If GDM cannot take a link, the browser keeps it.

What you get:
- Several connections per download
- Pause and resume that survives a restart
- A speed limit and a limit on how many run at once
- Plain messages when something fails
- Everything stays on your computer

Free.
